afcd.name: Australian Food Composition Database (AFCD), Release 3
afcd.licence: FSANZ Data User Licence Agreement, based on CC BY-SA 3.0 Australia
afcd.copyright_notice: © Food Standards Australia New Zealand (FSANZ), Australian Food Composition Database, Release 3.
afcd.changes_made: Converted from the published Excel nutrient profiles to JSON; retained selected per-100-g nutrient columns and source food IDs, names, classifications and derivation labels. Nutrient values are unchanged.
afcd.limitation_of_data_statement: There are limitations associated with food composition databases. Food composition data used in the database or databases may represent an average of the nutrient content of a particular sample of foods and ingredients, determined at a particular time. The nutrient composition of foods and ingredients can vary substantially between batches and brands because of a number of factors, including changes in season, processing practices and ingredient source, and methods of calculation.
afcd.australian_data_statement: This work is based on Australian data. Australia data may not be appropriate for use in other countries.
afcd.disclaimer: The source work is provided as-is. FSANZ gives no warranty concerning the contents or accuracy of the work, its fitness for purpose, or absence of errors.

component_semantics.available_carbohydrate_without_sugar_alc: Sum of available carbohydrates excluding sugar alcohols; AFCD's equation excludes sugar alcohols.
component_semantics.available_carbohydrate_with_sugar_alcoho: AFCD's equation includes sorbitol, mannitol and glycerol. Other sugar alcohols are not included in this equation.
component_semantics.missing_values: Null means no value is reported; it does not mean zero.
component_semantics.use_limit: Separate reference dataset only. Do not infer a recipe ingredient match by name alone or use this source outside its stated Australian-data limitation.

fineli.name: Fineli Food Composition Database, Release 20
fineli.publisher: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
fineli.attribution: Source: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL), Fineli Food Composition Database, Release 20. The source table was converted from semicolon-separated CSVs to JSON; fields were joined by food ID, names were localized to Finnish, and missing values remain null.
fineli.component_semantics: Fineli nutrient component codes are retained in this importer: CHOAVL (available carbohydrate), FIBT (total dietary fibre), SUGOH (sugar alcohols), PROT (protein), FAT (fat).
fineli.missing_values: Null means no source value was reported; it does not mean zero.
fineli.portion_mass_semantics: Fineli foodaddunit MASS values are grams per the listed food-specific unit; no generic spoon, volume, or piece conversion is inferred.
fineli.use_limit: Reference data only. Recipe matching, edible-portion state, cooking retention, and serving scope still require review.
